headlines.title: Thanksgiving Desserts That Come Together in Minutes
headlines.description: From mini cheesecakes packed with big flavor to cranberry pecan granola cookies, TODAY nutrition and health expert Joy Bauer shares easy and healthy make-ahead Thanksgiving dessert ideas.

headlines.title: Iowa residents protest Army’s planned detonation of bomb-making chemicals
headlines.description: Iowa residents are raising concerns about the planned detonation of lead azide in Middleton, Iowa, scheduled for Friday. KWQC’s Chandler Brindley reports as residents worry that a cloud of lead dust could cause environmental contamination and health risks.

headlines.title: How to Take Care of Your Feet During the Hectic Holiday Season
headlines.description: Between traveling, icy sidewalks and hours in uncomfortable party shoes, the holidays can be hard on your feet. Podiatrist Dr. Ebonie Vincent-Sleet joins TODAY with her holiday foot health survival guide. Tips include choosing the right outdoor footwear, using compression socks, going with platforms over stilettos for party looks, elevating your feet at the end of the day and more.

headlines.title: Inside Look at Vacations Geared Toward People on GLP-1s
headlines.description: Along with focusing on diet and exercise, health and wellness resorts across the country are now catering to the millions of people using GLP-1 weight loss drugs like Ozempic, Zepbound, Wegovy and Mounjaro. The programs include cooking lessons, guided strength-training sessions, and health counseling about those weight loss medicines. NBC’s Vicky Nguyen reports for TODAY.
